name: Basic soil analysis
why_needed: Checks pH, EC and basic fertility where nutrition/root-zone causes are plausible.
decision_change: Can prevent unnecessary fertilizer purchases and guide whether nutrition is actually implicated.

name: Water analysis
why_needed: Useful where irrigation-water salinity or quality is suspected.
decision_change: May shift focus from fertilizer to irrigation/water management.

name: Qualified field inspection
why_needed: Visual field context can distinguish pests, disease and physiological stress.
decision_change: May determine whether laboratory diagnostics are justified.

name: Plant diagnostic test (ELISA/PCR as locally appropriate)
why_needed: Useful when a specific pathogen/virus is plausible and the result would change a high-impact decision.
decision_change: Can support or weaken a pathogen hypothesis before major action.
price_note: Editable demo estimate; test type and price vary by laboratory.

name: Farmer field observation checklist
why_needed: Low-cost evidence on symptom pattern, irrigation, roots and pest presence.
decision_change: Can narrow hypotheses before paid testing.
